title: Quantum Tumtum
description: Quantum Tumtum is a Qiskit Aer GPU simulation project containing a Bell-state example, a VRAM-capped statevector capacity benchmark, and a 27-qubit one-layer QAOA Max-Cut example. The QAOA example simulates a 27-node cycle and reports sampled cut statistics. The project is distributed under GNU GPL version 3.
